subject: marketing
objective: How big is the market we can actually serve and win?
instruction: A business is preparing a marketing & customers analysis. The question is: How big is the market we can actually serve and win. The tile covers Size the whole market, the part you can serve and the part you can win from a population, an annual spend and two shares you declare. The declared figures are: target population 20000; annual spend per customer 3000; serviceable share 0.25; obtainable share 0.20. Use market size (tam, sam, som) in a competitive market and industry context, and report the method's result.
